reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM to confirm that from now on he uses Dock 27 for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Driftwood project. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

I didn't save a separate note with gbrain's `remember` tool, because it gave no clear way to keep that note visible only to Marcus. gbrain already saves our DMs as facts that only he can see, so that saved message is how his dock change will be remembered. Because it came in a DM, I won't bring it up with anyone else or in any channel.
